calculation_steps: At fixed T=2pi, 2g0kT=(4pi,4pi,6pi), so Z0=1 and Hol0=exp(-i5pi)=-1 for r=(1/4,1/4,1/2).
Write xk=4pi delta_gk and mu=sum rk xk, yk=xk-mu; then delta_phi=Arg(sum rk exp(i yk)), sum rk yk=0.
Since |delta_gk|<=1/100, |yk|<=8pi/100 < B=44/175 using pi<22/7. Re sum rk exp(i yk)>=1-B^2/2>0 and |Im sum rk exp(i yk)|<=B^3/6 by sin y - y bound.
The xk have range at most 8pi/100. Rotating by their midrange puts them inside +/-4pi/100; therefore V>=cos(4pi/100)>=1-(22/175)^2/2=30383/30625>99/100.
Third-order drift locally follows from zero first moment: delta_phi=-(sum rk yk^3)/6+O(epsilon^5); the first-order uncorrected dynamical phase does not cancel without endpoint correction.
Python standard-library rational assertions and 125 float64 development grid checks pass; three odd-N fixtures demonstrate fixed-T continuity despite different moving exact recurrence.
